about: Mercbot's teams (D-105): a ready-made bundle of the library's templates for one situation, which Add a team makes into bots together, on the home's Team page. Each team has an id (lowercase words joined by -), what it's for ("home", for home and life, or "work"; Add bots lists them under those two headings, D-109), a name, a one-line description and its templates' slugs, in the order the team screen lists them. Every slug must be a template in this folder, once per team; Mercbot checks this file when it starts (packages/bots/src/server/teams.js) and the static checks run it too (tests/server/teams.test.js). This file is not a template.

teams.name: Busy household
teams.description: Chores, meals, the children's activities and school admin, bills and home repairs, for the whole household.

teams.name: Personal life
teams.description: Your habits, money, language practice, plants and job search: helpers for your own life.

teams.name: Local service business
teams.description: For a salon, a plumber, a clinic…: answers enquiries, books appointments, writes quotes, follows up customers and reviews, keeps receipts.

teams.name: Small shop
teams.description: Keeps an eye on stock, plans social posts, answers reviews, tidies receipts and follows up customers.

teams.name: Marketing team
teams.description: Plans social posts, writes blog articles and newsletters, watches your brand and competitors, and keeps your voice.

teams.name: Sales team
teams.description: Researches prospects, prepares calls, writes proposals, follows up deals and watches renewals.

teams.name: Software company

teams.name: Design studio

teams.name: Growing team (hiring)
teams.description: Writes job adverts, coordinates hiring, welcomes new starters, tracks time off and runs team check-ins.

teams.name: Office manager

teams.name: Startup founder
teams.description: The weekly numbers, meeting recaps, prospects, social posts, pull requests and supplier contracts, for a founder doing it all.

teams.name: Consultancy
teams.description: Researches prospects, prepares calls, writes proposals and recaps, polishes decks, follows up deals and keeps the invoices.
